extracted.name: Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms
extracted.description: This recipe for savory spinach-stuffed mushrooms includes a cheesy bread crumb filling made with three types of cheese: Gouda, mozzarella, and Parmesan.
ingredient_lines: 30 large whole fresh mushrooms, stems removed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Lightly grease 30 muffin cups with olive oil. Brush all sides mushrooms with remaining olive oil; place gill-sides-up into the prepared muffin cups.
Bake in the preheated oven until mushrooms just tender, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat egg, garlic, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl; stir in spinach, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, Gouda cheese, mozzarella cheese, and bread crumbs until evenly combined.
Remove mushrooms from oven; drain and discard any accumulated juice. Fill mushroom caps with spinach mixture; return to the muffin cups. Sprinkle mushrooms with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Bake until stuffing is hot and golden brown, about 10 minutes.
